* Justlife

Right now, thousands of people in the UAE book a cleaner through Justlife and expect them to show up on time, do excellent work, and leave their home better than they found it. That promise only holds if the cleaners are there, trained, motivated, and routed efficiently — which means someone has to own the daily operating reality of that supply chain: keeping cleaners deployed, partners accountable, costs disciplined, and quality high.
  
  
This is an operations role, not a strategy role. You'll run the DTC home cleaning business end-to-end — 300+ cleaners across multiple partner companies, a small on-ground team of account executives and roster agents, and measurable improvement in on-time performance, completion rates, and contribution margin within your first six months. Every day you'll make decisions that move the numbers: which partner hires next, how to incentivise productivity, where fuel and routing waste money, whether we're hitting our supply plan. This is what it means to own a real business line.
  
  
You'll love this role if you...
  
  

* You think in unit economics and get frustrated when a cost lever stays hidden in a spreadsheet instead of being fixed
* You've run a large field or blue-collar workforce (directly or through partners) and know exactly how to hold external teams accountable without being their boss
* You're energised by problems you can see and touch — you'd rather spend an hour in a van or at a partner accommodation than sit in a meeting
* You build teams that work without you, and you actively coach people into bigger roles
* You obsess over data quality because you know bad reports kill decisions, and you'll learn SQL or Power BI yourself rather than wait for someone to build your dashboard

What you'll own
  
  

* Drive sustained improvement in on-time %, completion rate %, promise-kept %, and absent rate % by building daily operating discipline — reviewing metrics with the team each morning, identifying blockers, and acting on them before they compound into service failures
* Lead and develop the on-ground operations team (2 account executives and 4 remote roster agents): set clear priorities, review performance daily, coach individuals toward higher capability, and manage accountability
* Own supply planning and growth: forecast cleaner headcount needed against demand by city and partner, manage onboarding pace and allocation across partner companies, and reduce time-to-deployment so new hires contribute faster
* Manage partner companies as senior counterparts: run monthly business reviews, hold them to service-level agreements and commercial terms, reconcile statements of account with finance monthly, and escalate issues before they become crises
* Design and drive cost and process projects that improve contribution margin — incentive structure redesigns, fuel and fleet controls, van routing optimisation, cleaner orientation and training — taking each from idea to measurable result
* Build and maintain reporting that surfaces what's driving performance: which partners are slipping, where attrition is highest, which cost levers moved margin, what's blocking supply. Act on what it shows
* Spend meaningful time in the field — in vans, accommodations, and partner sites — so you understand problems first-hand and your team sees you do the same

What tells us you're the one
  
  

* You've measurably improved operational metrics across a large field workforce — tell us a specific program you ran (incentive redesign, routing optimisation, vendor onboarding, training rollout, etc.) and the metric that moved as a result: completion rate up X%, on-time performance improved Y%, attrition fell Z%, or margin lifted by N%
* You can spot cause and effect: when a metric moves, you know whether it's partner execution, process design, incentive misalignment, or something else — and you know how to test your hypothesis before rolling out a fix
* You've managed blue-collar, field-based, or logistics workforces (home services, facilities management, staffing, last-mile delivery, quick commerce) — or run marketplace operations where supply quality depends on external partners. Results matter far more than years, but 5–7 years of this kind of work is the sweet spot
* You're fluent in data: you can build operating reports independently, interrogate a spreadsheet without help, and use SQL, Power BI, or AI tools to automate manual reporting so you have time to think
* You speak fluent English, written and spoken. Bonus: you speak languages common to the workforce in the UAE (Tagalog, Urdu, Arabic), or you have prior experience operating in the UAE market in home services, logistics, or staffing

Why Justlife
  
  

* Scale and impact: You'll run a real, revenue-generating business line serving thousands of customers across the UAE, managing hundreds of cleaners and multiple partner companies, with direct line of sight from your decisions to customer satisfaction and margin
* Clear growth path: this role is a launchpad into broader category leadership, multi-city operations, or general management as we scale across the GCC
* Close partnership with leadership: you'll work alongside the Business Development lead and the founding team, with real influence on strategy and resource decisions
* A fair, performance-driven culture: you'll be measured on the metrics you own, recognised through our JustHeroes program, and rewarded for results — not politics
* Startup benefits: a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife service credits, referral bonuses, and regular team experiences

You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:** Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:** Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:** Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:** Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:** Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:** MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* Prepare a monthly report: usage per customer, revenue, margin, top issues and growth opportunities.
* Give input on pricing, packaging and which customer segments to target.

Personal Qualities

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:** Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:** Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:** Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:** Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:** Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:** Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:** Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:** Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:** Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Material QA/QC Inspector is responsible for inspecting, testing, and verifying construction materials used in infrastructure and utility projects to ensure compliance with approved material submittals, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable authority requirements. The role involves conducting material inspections, reviewing test reports and certifications, monitoring material storage and traceability, identifying non-conforming materials, and coordinating with project teams to ensure only approved materials are incorporated into the works. The Material QA/QC Inspector plays a key role in maintaining quality assurance and quality control standards throughout the construction lifecycle.

* Conduct inspections of construction materials delivered to site to ensure compliance with approved material submittals, project specifications, and relevant authority standards.
* Inspect materials used in roadworks, wet utilities, dry utilities, drainage, sewerage, and other infrastructure construction activities.
* Verify material inspection requests (MIRs) and ensure all materials are inspected and approved prior to installation or incorporation into the works.
* Check material identification, manufacturer details, technical datasheets, conformity certificates, test certificates, and delivery documentation.
* Inspect construction materials, including cement, concrete, reinforcement steel, aggregates, asphalt, road base, subbase, soil, HDPE, GRP, DI pipes, valves, fittings, cables, and other infrastructure materials.
* Ensure delivered materials comply with approved samples, specifications, dimensions, grades, and required technical standards.
* Verify proper storage, handling, transportation, and protection of materials at site to prevent damage, deterioration, or contamination.
* Coordinate with the QA/QC Engineer, Material Engineer, discipline engineers, and contractors regarding material inspections and approvals.
* Witness sampling and laboratory testing of construction materials in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
* Verify material test reports and certificates to ensure compliance with specified quality requirements.
* Identify damaged, defective, expired, or non-conforming materials and recommend rejection or replacement in accordance with project procedures.
* Monitor the traceability and proper identification of approved materials throughout the construction process.
* Ensure materials are procured from approved manufacturers and suppliers in accordance with project requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of material inspections, approvals, test reports, rejected materials, and related documentation.
* Report material quality issues and non-compliances to the QA/QC Engineer and Resident Engineer for necessary corrective action.
* Ensure compliance with project QA/QC procedures, HSE requirements, and applicable authority standards.
* Participate in material audits, site inspections, and quality meetings as required.
* Prepare daily material inspection reports and maintain updated material inspection registers.
* Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for project completion and final handover.

 **Qualifications**  

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7 **years of experience** in QA/QC inspection of construction materials on infrastructure, roads, utilities, sewerage, drainage, water, wastewater, or industrial projects.
* Strong knowledge of construction materials including concrete, reinforcement steel, aggregates, asphalt, road base, subbase, soil, HDPE, GRP, ductile iron (DI) pipes, valves, fittings, and utility materials.
* Experience reviewing Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), material submittals, test certificates, manufacturer certificates, and compliance documentation.
* Familiarity with project specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and quality management systems.
* Experience witnessing material sampling, field testing, and laboratory testing activities.
* Knowledge of international standards and specifications such as ASTM, AASHTO, BS, EN, ACI, and relevant authority requirements.
* Ability to identify, document, and report non-conforming materials and recommend corrective actions.
* Experience monitoring material storage, traceability, protection, and handling procedures.
* Strong understanding of QA/QC procedures, material approvals, inspection records, and project documentation requirements.
* Proficient in preparing inspection reports, material registers, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and quality records.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors, suppliers, laboratory personnel, engineers, and project stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems is preferred.
* Knowledge of HSE requirements and safe material handling practices.

You make a difference every day inside the team you sit with, enhancing clarity, direction, and scope, and keeping all the parts together with the other roles around you: Product Managers, Tech Leads, Designers, Software Engineers, ML Engineers and DevOps. You also contribute to AI71s hiring and branding initiatives for the TPM and Engineering functions.
  
  
**The team**
As a team, we maintain a shared mission and a roadmap that evolves with the organization. We are open to different styles, and we rotate responsibilities and initiatives between us so everyone gets to stretch. **Job Description**
**About AI71:**
ai71 builds enterprise-grade AI for the organisations that run the real economy: governments, banks and large enterprises across the Middle East & Africa. Our work is grounded in deep research and a commitment to deploying AI securely, responsibly and at scale.
  
  
“Ask” is our agentic AI platform. It puts AI agents to work on an organisation’s own knowledge, systems and workflows: agents that reason through complexity, draw on the organisation’s collective knowledge, and complete real work rather than just answer questions. Ask is built to be infrastructure and model-agnostic, so it runs inside a customer’s existing stack and security perimeter instead of forcing them onto ours. Today it is deployed across knowledge-heavy functions like legal, finance, HR and procurement, in some of the most regulated environments in the world.
  
  
**The Role**
As ai71 scales across the region, the gap between a signed contract and a working deployment has become one of the most consequential spaces in the business. Deployment Strategists own that gap. You sit inside the deployment strategy team, embedded with enterprise customers from first discovery through to steady-state adoption, acting as the bridge between what a customer needs and what ASK can do.
  
  
This is deliberately not a customer success or professional services function. It is hands-on and customer-facing. You run the engagement from kickoff to go-live, own the relationship with the customer’s operational and technical counterparts, work out how to configure Ask for their environment, stack and chosen models — because Ask is model- and infrastructure-agnostic, no two deployments look the same — design the testing and evaluation frameworks that prove it works, and keep a complex programme on cadence. What you learn feeds back into the product team: how we deploy, what we standardise, and where we invest in tooling.
  
  
**What Youll Do**
As a deployment strategist you are a trusted advisor to our customers. You are an expert at drawing out their requirements and pain points, distilling them to their core, and working with product and forward deployed engineers to ship deployments that move the customer’s numbers. You will:
  
  

* Own end-to-end deployment for one or more enterprise clients across a structured lifecycle, from commercial brief through to offboarding
* Own the business outcome of each deployment — adoption, value realised and the case for expansion — not just the go-live. A deployment that ships but isn’t used has not succeeded.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for client operational and technical stakeholders throughout each engagement, driving the client relationship forward and solidifying ai71 as a trusted partner
* Shape how clients define success early in each engagement — including evaluation criteria, acceptance thresholds, and what success looks like before go-live
* Define and run the deployment cadence, from kickoff, to regular check-ins and steercos, as well as user onboarding and platform training
* Work with customers to identify and map their AI use cases, helping them to define an agentic future state for their core processes and services
* Build and deliver demos for client stakeholders ranging from technical teams to executive sponsors focused on their desired business outcomes
* Work with Product and Engineering to translate client feedback into platform improvements and prioritised requests
* Improve the function itself: building the playbooks, templates and standards that make each deployment better than the last.

**What Youll Bring**
You bring 5+ years in product management, management or strategy consulting, program management, or an adjacent role where you have coordinated technical delivery in a fast-paced environment. Engineering management, technical product management and production roles are also common paths in — we are open to a range of backgrounds. Prior exposure to agentic systems, AI platforms or enterprise SaaS is a real plus. The role does not require coding or engineering experience, but you should be comfortable holding the room with technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  
  
Beyond experience, here are the qualities we are looking for:
  
  

* Ownership: you have a keen sense of ownership and can point to complex programs that would not have shipped without you. Not facilitating, owning. You are comfortable in environments where the playbook is still being written, and you shape the function rather than wait to be handed one.
* Technical depth: you can dive into AI concepts and hold your own with engineers — critiquing designs, surfacing risks, asking the question that makes an FDE pause. You know your way around the building blocks of modern AI products (LLMs, agents, evals, RAG, orchestration), or are hungry to get there fast, and you have spent real time building with agentic AI in both professional and personal settings.
* Relationships: you build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders at every level, all the way to the C-Suite. You know what makes them tick and how to take them on the change-management journey of AI adoption.
* Clarity: you connect the dots in ways others do not, especially around use cases, dependencies and organizational bottlenecks, and you strive to reach alignment through shared understanding, clear stakeholder management, and consistent direction.

This role is embedded with clients, so expect significant onsite time with customers across the UAE and the wider region.
  
  
We know many strong candidates won’t tick every box above. If your experience looks a little different but you believe you can bring value to this role, we would like to hear from you.

* Mission-Driven Work: Work on cutting-edge AI applications with a talented and passionate team, solving real-world challenges in critical sectors.
* Unparalleled Opportunity: This is a chance to innovate and solve real-world challenges using AI at a company with unique access to world-leading models and resources.
* Career Growth: We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and significant career growth opportunities as a foundational member of the team.
* World-Class Environment: Enjoy a flexible working environment and the latest tools & technologies needed to do your best work.

The role lead the end-to-end development of our AI-powered cybersecurity platform, owning its product vision, roadmap, and delivery. Acting as Product Owner and technical lead, you will translate the needs of our security teams (threat detection, investigation, response, and risk management) into AI capabilities built on classical ML and modern LLM/agentic architectures. You will guide a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and security specialists to ship a platform that is effective, reliable, secure by design, and trusted by its users across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Product Vision & Strategy
* Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI-driven cybersecurity platform aligned with business and security objectives.
* Identify and prioritize high-value security use cases (e.g., alert triage, threat hunting, incident investigation, vulnerability prioritization, threat intelligence summarization, automated response).
* Track the AI security tooling market and inform build vs. buy vs. partner decisions.
* Product Ownership & Delivery
* Own and prioritize the product backlog; write clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria with input from SOC, threat intelligence, and risk teams.
* Lead agile ceremonies (planning, refinement, reviews) and drive iterative delivery from MVP to production at scale.
* Define and track product KPIs and OKRs (e.g., analyst time saved, mean time to detect/respond, detection precision, adoption).

* Lead the design and development of the platform, including:

 Data ingestion and pipelines for security telemetry (SIEM, EDR, network, cloud, and identity logs, threat intelligence feeds).
  
  
 LLM, RAG, and agentic workflows with tool calling and integrations with security tools
  
  
 Model selection, fine-tuning, and serving across self-hosted options (open-weight models).
  
  
 Model gateways, prompt management, and guardrail policies.
  
  
 MCP servers and APIs that expose platform capabilities to other teams and systems.
  
  
 Analyst-facing experiences: copilots, dashboards, and human-in-the-loop review flows.
  
  

* AI Quality, Evaluation & Reliability
* Establish evaluation pipelines and benchmarks to measure the accuracy, robustness, bias, and hallucination rate of AI outputs on real security scenarios.
* Define SLOs/SLAs and observability for the platform, including fallback strategies and human escalation paths.
* Secure-by-Design Development
* Ensure the platform itself is secure by design: threat modeling (e.g., MAESTRO, OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS), secure CI/CD, dependency and model supply-chain checks, and policy-as-code.
* Protect the sensitive security data handled by the platform through data classification, masking, DLP, and least-privilege access.

* Partner with red teams to test the platform against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and agent misuse before and after each release.
* Validate platform detections and recommendations against realistic attack simulations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Turn findings from testing and production incidents into backlog items and continuous product improvements.
* Governance, Compliance & Responsible AI
* Ensure the platform complies with applicable AI regulations and standards (e.g., EU AI Act, regional laws, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and internal AI use policies.
* Define responsible AI practices for the product: transparency and explainability of recommendations, data usage, model lifecycle, and third-party AI vendor risk.

* Act as the primary point of contact between security operations, engineering, business, and leadership; communicate roadmap, progress, and trade-offs.
* Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and security specialists; manage vendors and partners as needed.

Responsible to serve as the source of truth about passengers, who they are, what they value and where they struggle to ensure that design, investment and operational decisions across HIA are based on evidence. Own end-to-end Voice of Customer programme, from data collection and research through to insight generation and strategic dissemination, ensuring every major capex, technology, and service-design decision is backed by robust passenger evidence, reducing wasted spend and improving the return on every investment in the airport, to ensure HIA is a customer-centric airport.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategic**

* Define and evolve the VoC strategy across all HIA touchpoints (landside, airside, retail, lounge, transfer, arrivals), aligning measurement frameworks with MATAR's wider CX Strategy & Roadmap and commercial objectives, to ensure passenger insight remains central to long-term planning.
* Design and maintain passenger segmentation models, personas, and end-to-end journey maps (e.g., premium, family, PRM, transfer, O&D) so that CX initiatives, capital projects, and commercial offers are targeted to clearly defined passenger needs rather than assumptions.
* Develop and present executive-level insight packs (with clear "so-what" narratives and prioritised recommendations) for APC, the CX & Brand Committee, and project steering groups, to embed passenger evidence into investment cases and governance decisions.

**Operational**

* Establish an insight-led decision-making culture by implementing a policy requiring all major design, technology, and capex proposals to reference VoC data, reducing the volume of "unknown" or anecdotal decisions across the organization.
* Partner with Qatar Airways (QR), Qatar Duty Free (QDF), and Qatar Aviation Services (QAS) analytics teams to link passenger satisfaction insights with loyalty, dwell-time, and commercial-spend data, enabling a unified view of passenger value and behavior across the airport ecosystem.
* Benchmark HIA's VoC programme against global best practice (Skytrax, ACI ASQ, and leading hub airports) to identify emerging methodologies, technologies, and standards, ensuring HIA maintains its competitive edge in passenger experience measurement.
* Identify and prioritise passenger pain points and opportunity areas through root-cause analysis and trend monitoring and translate these into a prioritised improvement backlog that informs the CX Roadmap and annual business planning cycle.
* Champion data governance and ethical research standards across all VoC activities, ensuring compliance with Qatar data-protection regulations and international best practice for passenger privacy, consent, and data security.
* Own and operate the integrated VoC collection ecosystem - including CSAT/NPS surveys, SMS and QR code intercepts, digital feedback channels, social-media listening, and complaint/compliment analysis - to maximise coverage and response rates at every key passenger touchpoint.
* Commission and conduct targeted qualitative research (ethnographic studies, passenger interviews, journey shadowing, mystery shopping, and UX testing) to uncover deep behavioral insights that quantitative data alone cannot reveal.
* Manage closed-loop feedback processes by routing actionable alerts to relevant operational teams (e.g., facilities, operations, security), tracking resolution, and reporting back to passengers where appropriate, to demonstrate that feedback drives tangible change.
* Administer and optimize VoC technology platforms (e.g., survey tools, text/sentiment analytics, dashboards) to ensure data accuracy, system reliability, and integration with business-intelligence infrastructure.
* Coordinate fieldwork logistics for passenger intercept surveys, pop-up research, and observational studies across the terminal, working with airport operations and security to ensure research activities do not disrupt passenger flow or operational efficiency.
* Produce ad-hoc insight briefings and rapid-turnaround analyses in response to emerging issues (e.g., disruption events, new facility openings, seasonal peaks), equipping leadership with real-time passenger sentiment to guide immediate decisions.
* Manage external research vendors and agency relationships, including scope definition, procurement, quality assurance, and budget control, to ensure third-party deliverables meet HIA's standards for rigor and relevance.
* Build internal VoC capability by training and coaching cross-functional stakeholders (project managers, operational leads, commercial teams) on how to interpret and apply passenger insights in their day-to-day decision-making.
* Maintain a centralized insights repository that is accessible to authorized stakeholders, ensuring historical data, research reports, and persona documentation are well-organised, version-controlled, and easily retrievable.
* Perform other department duties related to his / her position as directed by the Head of the Department

* Ability to articulate the distinguishing characteristics between segments of an audience
* Experience in survey tool software.
* Experience in developing voice of the customer dashboards and presentations.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. * **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.

-------------------------------------------

* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.

**HOW WE WORK**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.

* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Service Management Manager to lead Managed Service Provider (MSP) governance, ITSM operations, vendor performance management and continuous service improvement across the enterprise.

This role is accountable for ensuring reliable, high-quality technology services through effective vendor oversight, structured service governance, incident management and operational performance monitoring.

The successful candidate will bring approximately 15 years of overall IT Service Management experience, including at least 5 years in a Service Management Manager or equivalent leadership capacity. They will have the experience and confidence to manage external service providers, establish accountability, oversee service delivery and work effectively with senior technology stakeholders.

Equally important is the ability to adapt to changing business priorities and evolving technology requirements. We are looking for someone who combines strong management experience with a practical, collaborative and hands-on approach.

This is not a traditional service desk management role. It is a governance-focused position requiring strong MSP oversight, vendor accountability, ITIL process management, major incident leadership and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1. MSP Governance & Vendor Management

* Own and oversee the performance of third-party Managed Service Providers across enterprise IT services.
* Manage vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, availability targets, response and resolution times.
* Establish and maintain vendor governance frameworks, performance scorecards, escalation procedures and accountability models.
* Lead monthly and quarterly service reviews with MSPs, identifying service gaps and driving corrective action plans.
* Hold service providers accountable for performance issues, recurring incidents and contractual commitments.
* Build strong relationships with internal technology teams, procurement, business stakeholders and external service providers.
* Identify opportunities to improve vendor performance, service quality, operational efficiency and value for money.

2. IT Service Management & ITIL Governance

* Govern and continuously improve enterprise ITSM processes in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Oversee Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, Knowledge and Technology Continuity Management.

* Monitor ticket quality, backlog aging, incident trends, reassignment rates and overall service management effectiveness.

* Partner with technology leadership to establish meaningful service management KPIs and performance measures.
* Conduct ITSM maturity assessments and identify opportunities to strengthen governance, processes and operational capabilities.

* Identify systemic service issues and work with vendors to implement sustainable improvements.

* Monitor change success rates, unauthorized changes and incidents resulting from production changes.
* Work with technology teams and service providers to minimize operational disruption during technology changes and implementations.

* Develop and maintain service performance dashboards and executive-level reporting.
* Translate service management metrics, including MTTR, availability, incident trends, backlog health and change success rates, into meaningful operational and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, reduce recurring incidents, minimize downtime and enhance the end-user experience.
* Lead continuous service improvement initiatives aligned with organizational priorities.
* Recommend process improvements, automation opportunities and enhancements to service delivery models.
* Partner with senior technology leadership to improve transparency, operational accountability and service performance.

6. ITSM Transformation & Technology Enablement

* Identify opportunities to modernize IT service management through workflow automation, improved self-service capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Support enhancements to ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
* Explore AI-enabled ITSM capabilities to improve incident management, knowledge management, service request handling and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and service providers to implement practical improvements.
* Adapt service management practices as technology, business requirements and organizational priorities evolve.

* Ensure continuity runbooks and recovery procedures are tested and validated before high-risk technology initiatives or changes.

Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**The opportunity**

  

Payroll is a business-critical function, and organizations are looking for more efficient, technology-enabled ways to deliver it.

  

We’re looking for a senior payroll or employment tax professional who knows the market, sees where it’s going and wants to turn those insights into growth.

  

As a Director in EY’s Payroll Operate team, you’ll lead significant client relationships and help organizations transform how payroll is managed through EY’s managed payroll services. You’ll oversee complex payroll operations and new client transitions, bring together people, process and technology, and help build scalable solutions that improve the payroll experience.

  

This is an opportunity to combine payroll leadership, client delivery and commercial thinking while helping shape the growth of EY’s Payroll Operate business in Canada and contribute to the global business.

  

This posting does not relate to an existing vacancy. We are actively recruiting for this strategic hire to support the continued growth and development of our business.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead managed payroll services for complex client organizations, with accountability for quality, controls and client experience.
* Build strong relationships with senior payroll, HR and finance leaders and provide practical guidance on payroll operations.
* Lead new client implementations and transitions, establishing effective processes, governance and service expectations.
* Oversee end-to-end payroll delivery, including processing, reconciliations, reporting and payments.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate payroll through technology and better ways of working.
* Shape and grow the business by identifying market opportunities and expanding our work with Canadian and multinational organizations.
* Grow client relationships and contribute to new opportunities, proposals and payroll solution design.
* Develop high-performing teams through coaching, collaboration and clear leadership.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong knowledge of Canadian payroll and the end-to-end payroll lifecycle.
* Understanding of global payroll and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across regions and countries to support organizations with global operations.
* Deep familiarity with enterprise payroll and HRIS systems (e.g., ADP, Workday, Dayforce), multi-jurisdictional tax laws, and advanced data analytics/Excel proficiency
* Experience leading complex payroll operations, implementations or managed services.
* Ability to build credibility and strong relationships with senior clients.
* A continuous improvement mindset and interest in payroll technology, automation and transformation.
* Strong operational judgment with the ability to manage risk and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Collaborative leadership style with a focus on developing people and teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* Typically, 10+ years of progressive payroll experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, human resources or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of Canadian payroll requirements, processes, controls and reporting.
* Experience leading payroll teams, complex implementations, client relationships or significant payroll programs.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have,**

* A PLP, PCP, CPA or other relevant professional designation.
* Experience in managed payroll, outsourced payroll or a shared services environment.
* Experience transitioning payroll operations to a new delivery model or provider.
* Exposure to payroll technology, automation, data analytics or transformation.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution design or new client opportunities.

* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, contact records, follow-up activities and revenue forecasts.

* Act as the main operational contact for assigned accounts and follow through on commitments.
* Conduct regular client meetings, site inspections and service reviews to identify concerns and additional service needs.
* Resolve client concerns promptly and professionally, coordinating corrective actions with the team.
* Lead renewal discussions and identify opportunities to expand the scope of existing contracts.

* Monitor staffing levels, overtime and deployment against contractual requirements and approved budgets.
* Develop and update post orders, patrol procedures, emergency contacts and operational checklists.
* Oversee the use of CCTV, access control, alarms and patrol reporting systems at assigned sites.
* Review timesheets, attendance records and patrol logs, resolving discrepancies before payroll and billing deadlines.
* Coordinate uniforms, radios, keys, access cards and other equipment.
* Manage new site launches, including staffing, training, equipment and reporting arrangements.

* Ensure incidents are documented accurately, escalated promptly and handled confidentially.
* Review incidents and complaints, identify contributing factors and follow up on corrective actions.
* Use attendance, coverage, incident and client feedback records to identify training needs and operational improvements.
* Promote safe working practices, respectful conduct and compliance with company policies and applicable requirements.

* A proven ability to generate leads, reach decision-makers, conduct sales meetings, prepare proposals and close business.

* Experience maintaining a sales pipeline and working toward measurable sales and revenue targets.

* **3-5 years of experience as a Security Buisness Development Manager** with a licensed security services organization.

* Current First Aid and CPR certification.
* Experience managing security guards and supervisors, preferably across multiple client sites.
* Strong leadership skills and an approachable, accountable management style.
* Experience managing schedules, arranging coverage and balancing operational and client priorities.
* Sound judgment and the ability to remain composed during incidents or unexpected changes.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, including proposal preparation and accurate report writing.
* Working knowledge of patrol operations, surveillance, access control and emergency response.

* A valid driver’s licence and the ability to travel reliably to client and prospective client sites.

**About 3K Solutions**

3K Solutions Inc. is a growing telecommunications construction company specializing in fibre optic network deployment, multi-dwelling unit (MDU) construction, inside-wire installations and telecommunications infrastructure across Canada.

As we continue to expand our Ontario operations, we are seeking experienced and reliable telecommunications subcontractors to support our growing portfolio of Multi-Dwelling Unit (MxU) Brownfield fibre optic projects in St. Catharines and the surrounding Niagara Region.

We are looking to establish long-term relationships with subcontractors capable of independently executing complete building assignments, from initial construction through final testing and project closeout.

Small telecommunications companies, owner-operated businesses and experienced installation crews are encouraged to apply.

**Compensation Structure**

This is a business-to-business subcontracting opportunity compensated entirely on a piece-rate basis.

The advertised daily compensation represents estimated gross subcontractor revenue based on completed work and productivity. It is not a guaranteed daily or hourly rate.

A detailed rate card will be provided to qualified subcontractors prior to project commencement.

All agreed rates must be inclusive of:

* Labour and field supervision.
* Vehicles, fuel and transportation.
* Tools and installation equipment.
* Fibre splicing and testing equipment, where applicable.
* Personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Commercial liability insurance and WSIB coverage.
* General operating expenses and overhead.
* Project documentation and quality control.

Subcontractors are responsible for managing their own manpower, productivity and operating expenses.

**Scope of Work**

Projects primarily involve upgrading existing residential apartment buildings with fibre optic infrastructure.

The scope of work includes, but is not limited to:

* Brownfield MxU/MDU fibre optic construction.
* Inside Wire (ISW) and Outside Plant (OSP) installations.
* Installation of EMT, PVC conduit and surface-mounted raceway.
* Construction of vertical risers and horizontal distribution pathways.
* Drilling and installation of suite penetrations.
* Fibre optic cable pulling, routing and securement.
* InvisiLight and in-suite fibre installations.
* Installation of FDHs, iFDHs, NAPs and associated telecommunications hardware.
* Fibre optic connector installation and termination.
* Fibre optic fusion splicing.
* OTDR and OLTS testing.
* Firestopping of penetrations in accordance with project specifications.
* Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and construction packages.
* Project documentation and deficiency remediation.

**Subcontractor Requirements**

Successful subcontractors must:

* Operate as a registered business.
* Have demonstrated experience in telecommunications construction and fibre optic installations.
* Provide their own qualified field personnel and on-site supervision.
* Supply their own vehicles, tools, equipment and PPE.
* Have sufficient manpower to meet agreed project deadlines.
* Be capable of independently managing assigned construction projects.
* Maintain valid WSIB coverage and clearance.
* Carry a minimum of $2 million in Commercial General Liability insurance, naming 3K Solutions Inc. as an additional insured.
* Maintain all applicable health and safety training and certifications.
* Comply with Ontario occupational health and safety regulations.
* Maintain professional conduct when interacting with residents, property managers and building representatives.
* Take responsibility for workmanship, quality control and deficiency remediation.
* Have reliable communication and strong organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience completing Brownfield MxU/MDU fibre optic builds.
* Experience working on major Canadian telecommunications networks.
* FTTH and FTTP construction experience.
* Experience working in occupied residential apartment buildings.
* EMT conduit bending and installation.
* Fibre optic splicing, termination and testing experience.
* Experience with concrete scanning, drilling and coring.
* Established crews of two or more technicians.
* Ability to manage multiple building assignments.

Contractors qualified to perform asbestos-related work in accordance with Ontario regulations are encouraged to identify these capabilities in their application. Asbestos-related qualifications are not mandatory for general telecommunications construction assignments.

**Project Management and Documentation**

Subcontractors are expected to maintain consistent communication with the 3K Solutions project management team throughout each assigned project.

**Daily requirements include:**

* Construction progress updates through Google Chat.
* Field Level Hazard Assessments (FLHAs).
* Timestamped installation and suite penetration photographs.
* Reporting of construction challenges, delays and site conditions.
* Fibre routing and installation documentation.
* Submission of applicable testing results.
* Completion of project closeout documentation.

Subcontractors are expected to take ownership of their assigned projects without requiring continuous on-site supervision from 3K Solutions.

* Long-term subcontracting opportunities.
* Clearly defined scopes of work and agreed piece rates.
* Dedicated project management and administrative support.
* Opportunities to increase earnings through efficient project execution.
* Opportunities to expand your crew and take on additional building assignments.
* Opportunities for future projects throughout Ontario.

Our objective is to establish long-term partnerships with contractors who demonstrate consistent productivity, quality workmanship, accountability and professionalism.

* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.

We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own and maintain the integrated schedule and critical path across multiple Memory Interface IP development and release workstreams, from project kickoff and architecture through design closure, verification, customer delivery, and production readiness. Model dependency chains deeply enough to quantify the impact of slips and pull-ins, distinguish paths with float from those without it, and update the plan weekly using current engineering data.
* Drive the weekly project cadence by synthesizing inputs from architecture, RTL, design verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, packaging, software, infrastructure, product engineering, and post-silicon teams into a single view of program health, emerging concerns, and required actions.
* Track verification convergence and engineering maturity as leading indicators. Monitor feature readiness, RTL closure, bug discovery and closure trends, regression health, coverage, design maturity, and block-level readiness. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive a recovery plan before downstream milestones or customer commitments are affected.
* Analyze schedule scenarios and coordinate recovery plans. Work with engineering leads to understand technical constraints, resource limitations, and available float; quantify the impact of changes; develop practical options; and track agreed recovery actions to closure.
* Manage external partner and customer dependencies by owning delivery calendars, tracking execution plans and acceptance criteria, aligning technical dependencies, and supporting schedule negotiations with a clear understanding of downstream technical, commercial, and resource impacts.
* Lead cross-functional risk, issue, and decision management. Convert technical uncertainty into clear options, owners, dates, and decision points. Ensure risks, assumptions, and trade-offs are visible early and resolved at the appropriate level.
* Provide concise project insight to executives and customers. Distill complex engineering information into evidence-based updates that distinguish signal from noise, quantify schedule and delivery impact, and clearly identify the actions or decisions needed.

A Day In The Life
  
  
You start the morning reviewing verification-convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug-closure velocity has slowed. You bring the DV lead and RTL owner together for a focused sync, clarify the cause, and align on a recovery plan before the weekly project review.
  
  
In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects an internal delivery shift, quantify the downstream impact on release timing and customer commitments, and identify the decisions needed to protect the plan. Later, you follow-up with R&D on the strategy to take to resolve the issue, then finish the day preparing a concise executive summary and following up on owners and due dates from the project review.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor, silicon IP, SoC, ASIC, or complex hardware development.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex semiconductor or silicon IP programs across multiple engineering disciplines and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong working knowledge of semiconductor development lifecycles and the relationships among architecture, RTL, verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, software, infrastructure, and productization.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with meaningful dependency and critical-path modeling, including float analysis, milestone confidence, and the downstream effects of schedule changes.
* Experience using engineering evidence such as feature readiness, bug trends, regression results, coverage, design closure, and delivery health to assess schedule risk and drive corrective action.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical and program information, develop practical options, and recommend a course of action.
* Strong communication and influence skills, including the ability to gain cooperation across engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners and to present crisp status and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience with project and program management tools and data-driven reporting. Familiarity with Jira, schedule-management tools, dashboards, and engineering lifecycle metrics is preferred.
* Knowledge of quality-management processes and the ability to navigate Linux environments are considered assets.

Our engineering teams develop advanced Memory Interface IP that enables customers to build high-performance, differentiated SoCs. This individual will be responsible for managing day-to-day service activities, coordinating field teams, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring roofing repairs and maintenance projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and to a high standard.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of commercial roofing systems with excellent leadership, organizational, and customer service skills. This is an opportunity for an experienced roofing professional to take ownership of a service operation, improve operational performance, develop client relationships, and contribute to the continued growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* **Service Operations:**
  Oversee daily roofing service and repair activities, ensuring work orders are prioritized, scheduled, and completed efficiently.
* **Team Management:**
  Lead and coordinate roofing service technicians, foremen, and field crews, promoting productivity, accountability, and high-quality workmanship.
* **Scheduling and Dispatch:**
  Organize labour, materials, equipment, and subcontractors to meet customer requirements and service deadlines.
* **Customer Relationships:**
  Act as the primary point of contact for customers, property managers, facility managers, building owners, and general contractors.
* **Estimating and Quoting:**
  Assess service requests, determine repair requirements, prepare estimates and quotations, and ensure accurate work-order documentation.
* **Technical Oversight:**
  Provide guidance on commercial roofing repairs, leak investigations, preventative maintenance, and roof condition assessments.
* **Financial Management:**
  Monitor service revenue, labour costs, material expenses, job costing, and profitability.
* **Business Development:**
  Identify opportunities to grow service agreements, preventative maintenance programmes, repeat business, and existing customer accounts.
* **Health and Safety:**
  Ensure all work complies with applicable Ontario health and safety legislation, working-at-height requirements, and company procedures.
* **Quality Assurance:**
  Monitor completed work, resolve customer concerns, and ensure repairs and maintenance meet required standards.
* **Reporting and Administration:**
  Maintain accurate service records, schedules, job costing information, customer reports, and performance metrics.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Previous experience within the commercial roofing industry, ideally in service, repairs, and maintenance.
* Experience managing roofing technicians, field crews, foremen, or service operations.
* Strong knowledge of commercial roofing systems, including flat roofing, single-ply membranes, modified bitumen, and built-up roofing.
* Experience coordinating service calls, scheduling labour, managing work orders, and overseeing multiple jobs simultaneously.
* Understanding of estimating, quotations, job costing, invoicing, and service department profitability.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Knowledge of health and safety requirements relevant to commercial roofing operations in Ontario.
* Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel to job sites as required.

Desirable Experience
  
  

* Previous responsibility for managing a commercial roofing service department or division.
* Experience with preventative maintenance programmes and recurring service contracts.
* Established relationships with property management companies, commercial building owners, and industrial facilities.
* Familiarity with service management software, work-order systems, and job-costing platforms.
* Experience growing service revenue, improving margins, and developing new business opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits
  
  

A competitive compensation package will be offered, commensurate with experience, alongside potential performance-based incentives and company benefits.

Ideal Candidate
  
  

The ideal candidate will be a commercially minded roofing professional who understands both the technical and operational aspects of service work. They will be confident leading field teams, coordinating multiple service requests, managing customer expectations, and taking ownership of service quality and profitability. The ability to build lasting client relationships while improving the efficiency and growth of a roofing service operation will be key to success in this role.

This role leads Cleaning Leads and Cleaning Supervisors across your assigned portfolio. -----------------

**A massive opportunity for your career.** You lead people from day one. Cleaning Leads and Supervisors report to you, and you get real ownership over how your portfolio performs, quality, cost, and client satisfaction all in your hands.

* Travailler en collaboration avec les autres lignes de services du pôle Conseil.

* 7 ans d'expérience combinée dans le secteur et le conseil au sein des services financiers, de préférence avec une expérience dans le domaine de la gestion de patrimoine et d'actifs.
* Expérience dans l’accompagnement d’initiatives de transformation opérationnelle au sein du secteur des services financiers, avec un intérêt pour la gestion de patrimoine et d’actifs.
* Diplôme universitaire en commerce, gestion ou opérations, ou MBA ou équivalent délivré par une université accréditée.
* Aisance à travailler tant au niveau conceptuel que pratique, avec de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et un état d’esprit axé sur la croissance.
* Capacité avérée à établir des relations efficaces avec les clients et à travailler en collaboration avec les principaux décideurs.
* Expérience dans l’accompagnement d’activités de développement commercial, de développement de pratiques et de mise en œuvre de projets.

Shared Health leads the planning and coordinates the integration of patient- centered clinical and preventive health services across Manitoba. ****Position Overview****
Lead a team of technical and clinical support staff in the provincially integrated delivery of diagnostic operations. Inspire and lead laboratory staff across the organization to embrace and adopt integrated, patient-centred care pathways and service delivery models. Provide service-delivery focused operational leadership to laboratory and imaging operational services, partnering closely with the senior leadership of the diagnostic operations (Discipline team) and executive (Provincial Medical Specialty Lead of Laboratory Medicine & Provincial Medical Specialty Lead for Radiology, Executive Director - Provincial Lab Operations as well as the Executive Director for Diagnostic Imaging Operations) to support the operation of a leading edge, efficient, and high-quality service in line with the values of the organization.

+ 5 years of direct diagnostic operations delivery across one or more assigned geographic areas, such as:

- Primary health and community diagnostic services (Lab and Diagnostic Imaging)
- Acute inpatient, specialty care and complex ambulatory settings
- Integrating innovative diagnostics-based care models to optimize efficiency and to deliver high quality care

* 3 years of management experience leading a diagnostic health service (laboratory and/or Imaging, and/or non-invasive cardiac testing).
* 3 years of experience participating in operational planning, implementing operational directives, and achieving formal quality, patient safety, service integration and partner collaboration goals and objectives.
* 3 years of experience building and leading a high-performing, diagnostics team in a publicly funded diagnostic operations delivery organization including influencing and collaborating with senior management.

* Post-secondary degree in a relevant health discipline from an accredited education institution.
* Post-graduate degree is an asset.

****Certification/Licensure/Registration****

* Active member of an associated regulatory body as appropriate.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Demonstrated comprehensive senior leadership capabilities. The provincial health system in Manitoba has adopted the LEADS in a Caring Environment framework.

* Interruptions to respond to questions from senior management in the organization, third-party compliance bodies, and vendors are common; incumbent is able to schedule dedicated and focused time for planning and concentration.

**Venor is proud to partner with Armour Transportation Systems in their search for a Director, Customer Service & Business Performance to join their team.**

Armour Transportation Systems has been moving freight and connecting communities since the early 1940s, when the company was founded just outside of Moncton, NB. Today, Armour is one of Canada's leading transportation and logistics companies, serving as the dominant gateway between Atlantic Canada and the world. With more than 2,000 employees and 24 terminals, Armour is also a Platinum Member of Canada's Best Managed Companies and a Top Fleet Employer.

As Director, Customer Service & Business Performance, you’ll be based at Armour’s head office in Moncton NB and lead Customer Service, and Business Reporting. Working closely with Operations, Sales, IT and senior leadership, you’ll set the measures that matter, lead improvement projects and build reporting that helps the business make better decisions.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Leading, coaching and developing the Customer Service team, and setting clear service standards, KPIs and accountability measures.
* Tracking customer and operational trends to spot recurring issues early and improve service levels, including On-Time Delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Driving the use of technology, automation and process improvements to improve service and reduce manual work.
* Leading the Business Reporting team to build and improve operational, customer and business performance reporting.
* Setting reporting standards so information is accurate, consistent and delivered on time.
* Partnering with IT to design and roll out automated reporting solutions and dashboards.
* Turning business data into clear insights, and presenting performance results to senior leadership.
* Leading cross-functional projects that improve efficiency, customer experience, service quality and business performance, from planning through to results.
* Identifying and prioritizing improvements across customer service, order entry, reporting and operations, including process mapping and change management.
* Measuring project outcomes to make sure expected benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Building a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus, with clear goals, development plans and succession plans for both teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A university degree in business, supply chain, operations or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in customer service in a business-to-business environment, including 5+ years leading teams and managers.
* A proven track record leading process improvement and cross-functional projects that deliver measurable results.
* Strong comfort with KPIs, reporting and data, and the ability to turn numbers into clear actions.
* Experience partnering with IT on reporting automation, dashboards or system changes would be a significant asset.
* A collaborative leader who builds trust, holds teams accountable and develops future leaders.
* Clear, confident communication skills, including presenting to senior leadership.
* Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, or relevant industries, a PMP or Lean / Six Sigma certification
* Bilingualism in English and French are considered assets.
