* **Expansion ARR** is new revenue closed inside your portfolio through upsell and expansion.

You implement the platform, configure it to the customer's payer mix and levels of care, train and coach their staff, take them live, and stay with them until clean claims are flowing.

This isn't a billing role, but it needs billing chops. You have to speak the language of billers, billing managers, and CFOs to earn their trust, find what's actually going wrong, and teach them to fix it. You teach the customer's team to run their revenue cycle on Opus RCM; you don't run it for them. Practices switch billing systems to fix something specific: claims that keep rejecting, AR aging past 90 days, a billing team fighting its own software. Going live is the means, not the goal. The Commercial AI & Data Strategy team, within the Chief Marketing Office, is responsible for developing and managing the data and data solutions that enable the U.S. Commercial business. A key priority is building AI-ready data products and agentic data operations that provide the trusted, scalable foundation for the company’s AI transformation and ultimately help accelerate innovative therapies to patients.

The Data Domain Enablement & Delivery Lead is a senior member of the Commercial AI & Data Strategy team within Artificial Intelligence Acceleration (AIA). The role applies deep pharmaceutical sales and marketing domain expertise to help business teams, applications, analytics products, and AI-enabled solutions identify, interpret, connect, and appropriately use commercial data to solve priority business needs.

This leader serves as the bridge between Commercial stakeholders and data, analytics, product, and engineering teams. The role ensures that business needs are translated into clear domain definitions, data requirements, relationships, rules, quality expectations, and fit-for-purpose data solutions. It guides delivery from problem definition and data discovery through implementation, adoption, and value realization, primarily supporting the U.S. Commercial business.

The role requires extensive knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial processes, therapeutic-area go-to-market strategy, and the HCP and patient dynamics that shape how commercial data must be interpreted and applied. This includes understanding the patient journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation, persistence, access, and outcomes; HCP specialties, referral and treatment networks, prescribing behavior, adoption dynamics, and engagement needs; and the implications of brand strategy, indication, line of therapy, market maturity, competitive context, field deployment, channel mix, and access conditions. The leader will connect this business context to customer and healthcare professional data, affiliations and account structures, product and indication data, prescription and sales data, patient and journey data, payer and access data, field-force alignment and activity, omnichannel engagement, marketing campaigns, next-best-action use cases, performance measurement, and customer intelligence. The objective is not simply to make data available, but to ensure the right data is applied in the right commercial and therapeutic context to support sound decisions and measurable outcomes.

The position leads colleagues and works across Commercial, analytics, digital, data, AI, and technology organizations to accelerate delivery, strengthen data understanding, improve reuse, reduce interpretation gaps, and ensure that data products and solutions generate measurable business outcomes

Working closely with Commercial, Legal, and Privacy teams, the role will help ensure that data is used consistently with regulatory requirements and contractual rights, while enabling the business to confidently leverage data, accelerate innovation, and scale AI responsibly.

* Lead the Commercial data domain. Combine data expertise with therapeutic-area strategy, HCP and patient dynamics, and customer context to guide how data is defined, connected, interpreted and applied.

* Build reusable domain knowledge. Own the shared business definitions, glossaries, semantic models, taxonomies and data-product documentation that people and AI agents rely on.

* Enable the people who use the data. Coach business users, analysts, data scientists and application and AI teams hands-on, and run discovery and solutioning sessions that link objectives to available data products.
* Drive delivery with Product Owners. Shape roadmaps for sales, marketing, analytics and AI capabilities, turn priorities into epics and acceptance criteria, coordinate Commercial, data and technology teams, and validate that outputs match the real commercial process.

Stanley Consultants is seeking a highly energetic and entrepreneurial person who enjoys working in a team environment to lead and build our water instrumentation & controls (I&C), SCADA and digital water consulting services initiative through business development and project delivery. The position serves in a “seller/do-er” role, with a main focus of matching technology and data integration solutions to client challenges via consulting engagements. The successful candidate will be well-versed in the US water market, understand utility business operations, and have a firm grasp of emerging innovations and technologies that can disrupt the way professional planning, engineering, and construction management services are delivered and elevate our standing as the preferred consultant of our clients. This role will primarily focus on leveraging the existing local team and national water/wastewater practice members for the delivery of new I&C, SCADA and digital municipal water and wastewater projects. A mark of success in this role will be working with geographically assigned Client Service Managers (CSMs), specialty consultants, and our technology partners to identify, sell, and deliver I&C, SCADA and digital water projects.
  
  
**The successful candidate will enjoy:**

* The initiation, development, and maintenance of close client and staff relationships
* Interaction across multiple level stakeholders (asset owners to operators)
* Presenting solutions and outcomes to key customer stakeholders
* Inquisitive-minded customer engagement and listening skills (connecting the dots between customer needs and challenges to digital solutions)
* Commercially savvy business acumen and innovation
* Collaboration and relationship development with external strategic partner(s)
* Partnership formation, structuring and negotiations
* Support and feedback from the Water Market management team
* The delivery of water resources, water, and wastewater projects
* The execution of creative approaches to project development
* Proactive collaboration with the other Stanley market representatives
* Personal dedication to serving client needs

The position is tailored to support the corporate strategic plan’s implementation and is needed to advance our strong and existing I&C and SCADA practice and our new and unique digital water market strategy. The successful candidate will need to be aligned with the corporate strategy and culture. The successful candidate must possess and maintain deep expertise in the water market, and specifically: integrated asset performance & efficiencies, utility performance requirements, digital transformation & maturity, and the value of innovation ecosystems overall. The role will work in close partnership with the Water Market Leader and our technology partners to create and execute the water market’s digital go-to-market stage of implementation and will continue water market strategic plan development, roadmap development, prioritization, and negotiation support. The position will conduct research and due diligence on digital technologies and implementation methods, lead/support customer identification and lead digital maturity assessment efforts.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Support Stanley’s existing I&C and SCADA water practice
* Support Stanley’s digital water go-to-market strategy
* Lead sales and project implementation for I&C, SCADA and digital water market
* Listen to client needs relative to digital/smart water solutions that are available to address them
* Serve as lead project manager for Stanley’s digital water initiatives, coordinating the activities of data integrators, I&C engineers, data scientists, and civil/environmental engineers in the delivery of digital water solutions
* Develop and lead customer identification and prioritization (sales pipeline)
* Support CSMs, outside specialty consultants, and Water Market Leader in direct selling to clients of service and partnership offerings
* Conduct research to stay abreast of smart water technologies and competitor capabilities
* Support CSM’s to initiate, develop, and maintain close public and private client relationships at local, state, and national levels
* Leverages internal technical experts to gain footholds with new clients
* Leads or assists in the preparation of proposals, presentations, and contract procedures
* Leads or assists with client relations and participates in project delivery as required
* Actively participates in professional organizations focusing on digital water at the local, regional, and national levels
* Develops and implements creative and innovative approaches to project development
* Identifies target customers and conducts multi-channel outreach to convert prospects to sales including networking, cold calling, professional social media such as LinkedIn and other methods
* Leverages an existing network of water utility leaders and managers to build a pipeline of opportunities and convert them to sales
* Update and maintain leads, contacts and sales pipeline in the company CRM systems

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree
* 10+ years of relevant experience in innovation, project management, operations and delivery in water/wastewater or related public environment, including understanding of business development
* Possess knowledge of water/wastewater infrastructure, and the processes that clients go through to plan, finance, design, and construct it
* Possess and maintain an understanding of water resources (storm water and flood control) infrastructure
* High ethical standards, unquestionably trustworthy
* The successful candidate must possess strong interpersonal skills to effectively interface with clients in the water sector
* Must have demonstrated success in understanding the water technology and innovation markets
* Must be capable of directing and managing a multi-discipline team
* Dedicated to quality – “must do it right”
* Proven track record of successful project delivery
* Strong written and verbal communications skills

We realize there’s more to life than just work. We help you meet the demands of work, family and personal life through several flexible options.

Member-Owned. Member-ownership is at the heart of our culture, aligning client satisfaction, company performance, and personal reward.

Health Insurance. We provide a comprehensive insurance package including medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, Doctor On Demand, wellness reimbursement, and mental health resources.

* Travel occasionally to visit regional customers

The Red Hat Hybrid Platforms Product Management team is looking for a Principal Product Manager (technical) to own and drive identity solutions in Red Hat OpenShift.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you are responsible for how people, workloads, and software agents authenticate to OpenShift and how OpenShift decides what they are allowed to do. You will work with the Engineering and Product teams who build and deliver those capabilities. The product area includes:
  
  

* User authentication and authorization, including the OpenShift OAuth server and external OpenID Connect integrations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity, multi-cluster authentication on OpenShift clusters
* Identity and user federation to secure agentic workflows in OpenShift.

You will plan and deliver product content for new releases and launches, prioritize and communicate requirements to guide development, support the field in advanced sales opportunities, perform competitive reviews, and work with partners. You will contribute to company strategy and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Support, Sales, Security, and Field teams.
  
  
You will engage with the open source communities behind this work, including Kubernetes and other Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.
  
  
As a Principal Product Manager, you need great communication, teamwork, and persuasion skills to articulate the product vision, align teams across the company, and influence stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work on a core platform control alongside some of the brightest minds in open source.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Collect input from OpenShift users, customers, community members, and internal stakeholders on how enterprises manage identity, and turn that input into strategy and a roadmap
* Define the product vision, the customer problems to solve, and measurable outcomes for authentication, authorization, and workload identity.
* Define and use metrics for adoption and measuring success
* Research commercial and do-it-yourself alternatives and use that research for competitive positioning
* Prioritize and document requirements, epics, and user stories, with acceptance criteria, for new releases
* Guide major enhancements with OpenShift Engineering, Kubernetes upstream, and adjacent product teams.
* Drive the identity model that agentic features in OpenShift and related products use, and work with those product teams so agents obtain authority through OpenShift identity and authorization
* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.
* Support go-to-market work, including presentations, blogs, demos, workshops, events, and sales enablement, and review documentation for this area
* Keep Engineering, Support, and Field aligned on direction, and own the translation of strategy into a release plan

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of enterprise software experience in product management, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar technical product or customer-facing role
* A track record of leading cross-functional work on a platform, security, or identity management, and of influencing people who do not report to you
* Direct experience with Kubernetes identity management.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and or how enterprises use identity provider (e.g. Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Federate).
* Working knowledge of cloud workload identity. Depth in at least one of the following, and literacy in the others: AWS STS, Microsoft Entra workload identity, and Google Workload Identity or Workload Identity Federation
* A clear view of how a typical enterprise uses identity: single sign-on, group-based access, joiner-mover-leaver, non-human identities, and short-lived credentials as the default
* A clear view of how identity should work for agentic AI.
* Linux skills and direct experience with Linux containers and Kubernetes
* Working knowledge of the CNCF ecosystem and experience with open source projects
* Demonstrated ability to listen to customers, stakeholders, and engineering and turn that into product decisions
* Ability to handle several competing priorities
* Bachelor's or graduate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Willingness to travel up to 25%

**The Following Are Considered a Plus**

* Hands-on configuration of OpenShift identity providers, OAuth, external OpenID Connect, or cloud credential modes used by managed OpenShift
* Upstream participation in Kubernetes SIG Auth or a related CNCF project
* Experience with SPIFFE and SPIRE, LDAP, or Active Directory
* Understanding of zero trust principles.
* Experience with compliance programs in which identity is a control, such as FedRAMP or PCI
* Prior experience with agile delivery and with Jira or a similar tool
* A track record of enterprise product launches

**Meet the Team**
Cisco's Global Marketing team connects customers and partners with technology that helps their businesses grow. Within Strategy, Planning & Operations (SPO), we help marketing teams turn plans into action by improving how programs, processes, and tools work together.
  
  
Our team partners with marketing leaders and field teams across the Americas to simplify workflows, remove barriers, and help marketers spend more time engaging customers. We welcome new ideas, encourage collaboration, and look for practical ways to improve how we work.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Help shape how Cisco's Americas Field Marketing team operates!
  
  
As part of Global Field and Partner Marketing Strategy, Planning & Operations, you'll work with marketing leaders, Field Marketing Managers, and global program teams to improve how marketing programs move from planning to execution.
  
  
You'll focus on making everyday work easier for field marketers. From simplifying processes and improving tools to connecting teams and gathering feedback, your work will help marketers deliver programs more efficiently and respond to changing business needs.
  
  

* Simplify marketing workflows: Create and improve processes, intake models, checklists, and service level agreements (SLAs) that reduce administrative work and support consistent execution.
* Connect global and regional teams: Coordinate with global program teams, digital marketing, events, sponsorships, executive engagement, and field marketers to align priorities and support program delivery.
* Improve technology adoption: Help marketers use project management, reporting, collaboration, and AI productivity tools to simplify tasks and improve how work gets done.
* Make information easier to access: Develop and maintain process guides, documentation, and shared resources that help field marketers find answers and follow consistent practices.
* Turn feedback into improvements: Gather input from field marketers and global program owners to understand what's working, identify challenges, and recommend changes to marketing programs and processes.
* Remove barriers to execution: Identify gaps, repetitive tasks, and workflow challenges. Introduce process improvements and automation that save time and help teams focus on delivering results.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing operations, field marketing, program management, or go-to-market operations within an enterprise technology environment.
* Experience developing and implementing processes or workflows across large, cross-functional marketing organizations.
* Experience supporting B2B field marketing programs, including coordination between global marketing teams and regional execution teams.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise marketing and business tools, such as Salesforce, reporting platforms, project management systems, or AI productivity tools.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to align priorities, implement changes, and improve business processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing marketing programs or projects, including workflow design, process improvement, and operational planning.
* Experience identifying process challenges, developing solutions, and measuring the impact of operational changes.
* Experience connecting global marketing programs with regional field marketing or sales teams in a multinational organization.
* Familiarity with marketing operations technology, reporting and data analysis, workflow automation, and AI productivity tools.
* Experience developing process documentation, presenting recommendations to leadership, and helping teams adopt new ways of working.

Meet the Team**

* Collaborate across sales, finance, and business functions to align operational execution with our broader go-to-market strategy.

* 3+ years of experience building and maintaining complex forecasting models and pipeline visibility tools.
* 3+ years of experience managing CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and designing automated sales workflows.
* 3+ years of experience in conducting quantitative analysis of sales trends, margin performance, or pricing structures.
* 2+ years of experience partnering with finance and sales leadership to support go-to-market strategy execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Expertise in SQL, Tableau, or PowerBI to drive data-backed insights and reporting automation.
* Experience in a cross-functional role supporting multi-cloud or AI-focused product lines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex findings to senior sales leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new operational tools or processes.
* Adaptability in fast-paced, high-growth environments with a focus on project management and prioritization.

* Identifying recurring launch blockers (permitting delays, address data gaps, install backlogs) and driving process fixes back into the playbook.

* Proven track record managing multiple concurrent, deadline-driven launches or construction-to-activation handoffs.
* Strong cross-functional influence skills — comfortable driving alignment across construction, engineering, IT, sales, and care without direct authority.
* Hands-on proficiency with data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or advanced Excel) to build and automate launch scorecards.
* Willingness to travel to launch markets up to approximately 25% of the time.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A Bachelors degree.
* Experience with fiber-specific systems (GIS/mapping tools, address qualification platforms, permitting trackers).

The purpose of the Manager, Revenue Performance (Segment Strategist) is to serve as the chief architect of market growth, commercial strategy, and strategic revenue plays to achieve the organization's North Star: Driving sustainable, profitable revenue growth.

Operating as an autonomous, strategic thought partner to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), this role is fueled by deep intellectual curiosity about the end-to-end operations of the business. The incumbent systematically looks into every corner of the commercial engine—evaluating top-line expansion, gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), and churn mitigation—to uncover non-obvious levers that drive step-change growth.

This position establishes segment-level performance clarity, sizes high-confidence growth and risk levers (Enterprise, SMB, Government), models unit economics, forecasts early-stage customer friction, and translates complex operational data into scalable business processes, targeted improvement initiatives, and measurable commercial results. By integrating AI and enterprise automation into daily discovery, the Segment Strategist ensures long-term revenue predictability, capital efficiency, and sustainable revenue acceleration.

### **Key Responsibilities & Time Allocation (100%)**

* Serve as the strategic domain expert and "Human in the Loop" for enterprise BI and predictive models—stress-testing statistical assumptions against commercial realities, validating algorithmic risk signals, and translating complex data science into actionable revenue strategies.
* Identify, size, and economically model high-impact enterprise, SMB, and government growth opportunities (e.g., fleet migration pipeline mapping, camera green space capture rates) to guide go-to-market investments.
* Conduct econometric and sensitivity analyses on core revenue drivers (win rate, early-stage churn, NRR, pipeline velocity) across customer cohorts to maintain less than 5% revenue forecast variance per month.
* Model customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, unit economics, and segment-specific margin contribution to provide executive leadership with financial framing for capital deployment, sales capacity, and incentive design.

GTM Process Optimization & Commercial Enablement (20%)

* Translate diagnostic insights into high-impact operational improvements, working in close partnership with Sales Enablement and Frontline Leadership to drive behavioral adoption and commercial results.
* Design commercial deal-qualification frameworks, customer fit criteria, and margin guardrails that eliminate point-of-sale revenue fallout and protect booked MRR.
* Partner with Customer Success/Sales Enablement to operationalize competitive playbooks, objection-handling frameworks, and bundle packaging strategies across frontline sales cohorts.
* Evaluate and streamline GTM business workflows (e.g., lead routing, rep tiering structures) by operationalizing AI-driven frameworks and low-code automation to eliminate administrative drag and accelerate pipeline velocity.
* Monitor the ongoing adoption and financial ROI of deployed GTM programs, continuously refining enablement and sales motions to ensure sustained performance lift.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & GTM Alignment (35%)

* Strategic Revenue Liaison: Serve as the central strategic liaison between Sales Directors (Enterprise, SMB, Government), Finance, Product, and RevOps technical modelers to synchronize go-to-market strategies and eliminating silos and process breakdowns that cause revenue leakage.
* GTM Program Framework Architecture: Partner closely with pipeline and operations leads to architect program frameworks and Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) targeting parameters (e.g., account-tier thresholds, unit minimums, and deal-yield criteria) that direct frontline sales focus toward high-margin, high-retention opportunities.
* Executive Influence & Decision Alignment: Influence cross-functional leaders through objective data, qualitative narratives, and clear financial framing, driving consensus across the business on where to deploy capital, sales capacity, and operational effort.
* Joint GTM Strategy Orchestration: Co-lead the commercial operating cadence between Segment Strategy and GTM Operations, ensuring cross-functional handoffs between strategic insights, enablement rollout, and sales floor execution are seamless and measurable.

Executive Data Analysis, AI, & Predictive Reporting (15%)

* Oversee the deep extraction, econometric synthesis, and AI-accelerated modeling of complex segment data across Salesforce, Looker, and enterprise data warehouses to uncover leading indicators of churn, pipeline risk, or expansion upside.
* Transition fragmented, manual spreadsheets into unified, live executive dashboards (Airtable / Looker) that serve as the single source of truth for the ELT.
* Architect and leverage prompt-based AI frameworks, generative agents, and conversational intelligence tools to synthesize unstructured sales interaction data and competitor signals into real-time executive intelligence.
* Produce concise, qualitative executive narratives that explain why metrics are moving and define the specific operational actions required to accelerate performance.

Strategic Thought Leadership & ELT Advisory (10%)

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership by providing financial framing for accelerate/pause/stop decisions on portfolio programs and GTM bets.
* Mentor junior analysts and operations professionals, enforcing strict analytical rigor, data architecture standards, and peer-review quality control.

At T-Mobile Advertising Solutions (T-Ads), we're building privacy-first advertising and data products powered by advanced machine learning, large-scale data processing, and cloud technologies. Our proprietary algorithms enable rich consumer insights, intelligent audience solutions, and measurable performance for advertisers while maintaining a strong commitment to consumer privacy.  
  
We are seeking a passionate, creative, and curious Senior Data Science Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, software engineering, and big data, building AI and ML systems that directly impact our customers and business. You'll collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver innovative solutions at scale.  
  
This role leads the end-to-end design and engineering of production-grade data products and ML systems. It translates ambiguous business problems into statistically rigorous solutions, applying appropriate testing, validation, and evaluation frameworks aligned to business metrics. The work you do will directly shape the future of our products and technologies across T-Ads.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Independently leads end-to-end delivery of data products or ML systems (includes technical decisions and production accountability).
* Frames ambiguous problems and evaluates multiple solution approaches; clarifies ambiguous requirements and proposes structured solution strategies.
* Designs statistically rigorous solutions using appropriate statistical testing, inference, and validation techniques. Identifies subtle data quality, leakage, and distribution shift issues
* Designs, trains, tunes, and deploys ML/deep learning models using established techniques with evaluation frameworks aligned to business metrics.
* Designs and implements scalable training and deployment pipelines using PySpark, Snowpark or similar technologies. Understands batch/streaming, distributed processing and cloud technologies as required for projects.
* Writes production-ready code in common data science languages like Python (including AI/ML libraries), SQL, Scala; enforces engineering standards including CI/CD and automated testing.
* Mentors engineers and provides feedback on models, pipelines, and deployment readiness.
* Collaborates across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Authors technical design documents and leads design reviews.

* Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of related work experience OR Advanced degree with 3 years of related experience (Required)
* Acceptable areas of study include Quantitative Discipline (math, statistics, economics, computer science, physics, engineering, etc.) (Required)
* 4-7 years Industry experience in predictive modeling, data science, and analysis in an ML engineer or data scientist role building and deploying ML/deep learning models. (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience with common AI/ML programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala) (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience designing and working within big data architectures using distributed processing and storage technologies (e.g., Spark, Snowflake, Hadoop, Hive, Kafka), along with hands-on experience leveraging cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) to build scalable, reliable, and production-grade data and machine learning systems. (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience articulating and translating business questions and using statistical techniques to arrive at an answer using available data (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience working with relational and non-relational databases using SQL (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience in data visualization (Required)
* 2-4 years Experience in the advertising or similar industry (Preferred)

**Knowledges, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Critical Thinking: Ability to rigorously structure ambiguous problems, evaluate competing technical approaches using statistical and systems reasoning, anticipate failure modes, and make defensible decisions aligned to business impact. (Required)
* Mathematics: Ability to design statistically defensible evaluations, detect subtle validity issues, and quantify uncertainty in business-facing decisions. (Required)
* Machine Learning: Ability to lead end-to-end ML solutions, select appropriate model classes and loss functions aligned to business objectives, implement robust cross-validation and hyperparameter optimization strategies, productionize models via reproducible pipelines and CI/CD practices, and continuously monitor for drift, robustness issues, and system-level constraints (scalability, reliability, observability, and cost). The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred
* Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing channels — OOH, community partnerships, ambassador programs, geo-targeted digital preferred
* Experience developing audience segmentation frameworks and channel-audience matching strategies preferred
* Background in capability building — has developed training, toolkits, or frameworks adopted by a field team preferred

This is a new role within Full Bars, our in-house creative agency for Mint Mobile and Ultra Mobile. The first priority in this role is to navigate — standing up new vendors, issuing PRs and POs, and tracking invoices to make sure vendors get paid on time — in partnership with Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and vendors themselves. This will be the main focus in the early part of the role before expanding into the rest of the team's operations. Beyond that, this person will audit the team's current SOPs and make recommendations on how to optimize and improve the way the team works and lead the evaluation of Airtable (or another PM platform) as a potential replacement for Wrike — building out the templates, workflows, and customizations if approved, and continuing to own and optimize that platform over time. Success means the Mint Mobile and Ultra Mobile creative teams run on clear, well-managed processes — with strong visibility into capacity, and delivery for leadership.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Set up and document the end-to-end vendor, procurement, legal, and AP process using T-Mobile's current systems — standing up new vendors, issuing PRs & POs, and tracking invoices to make sure they're paid on time — partnering closely with Marketing partners, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and vendors on resourcing, onboarding, and contract/work-order coordination.
* Create, own and send a weekly status update on all open POs, so stakeholders always know where things stand.
* Set up and maintain agency budget trackers to keep spend organized and visible.
* Audit the creative account teams' current SOPs and creative operations and make recommendations on how to optimize and improve them — then own that documentation going forward.
* Lead the evaluation of Airtable (or another platform) as a potential replacement for Wrike for the Mint Mobile and Ultra Mobile creative teams and make a recommendation based on their needs.
* If a new platform is approved, build out all templates, workflows, and customizations from scratch, and roll them out to the Mint and Ultra teams.
* Own and continuously optimize the platform over time, adapting it as Mint Mobile and Ultra Mobile's needs change — this is an ongoing responsibility, not a one-time setup.
* Set up reporting so leadership has visibility into capacity and delivery across both brands.
* Standardize how the teams work: consistent templates, a clear intake process, a way to prioritize work, and a system for tracking projects — all built within Wrike, Airtable, or whichever platform is ultimately selected.
* Work with stakeholders across the business to confirm the teams' processes meet T-Mobile's compliance requirements.
* Own Full Bars’ creative operations tech stack agency-wide — the platforms and tools that power how the team works — and provide broader operations support as needed.
* Explore and apply AI tools to improve agency operations — identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, reporting, and repetitive tasks
* Be the first point of contact when someone on the Mint or Ultra creative teams hits a tools or workflow problem and help improve visibility into team capacity and delivery status.

**Qualifications:**

* 7-10 years Overseeing marketing operations, project management, or agency operations (client-side and/or in-house agency)
* 7-10 years Owning a PM/work-management platform (Wrike, Airtable, or similar) — including either leading a migration or making a platform recommendation to leadership
* 4-7 years Managing vendor and finance processes (PO issuance, invoice tracking, vendor onboarding) within a large corporate environment
* 4-7 years Working cross-functionally with Legal, Accounts Payable, and Procurement teams
* 4-7 years Experience working within an advertising agency, marketing agency, or in-house creative team structure
* Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States
